constraints.definition: CHECK ((((duplicate_of IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (context_body IS NULL) AND (context_sha256 IS NULL) AND (NOT effect_applied) AND (NOT launch_claimed)) OR ((duplicate_of IS NULL) AND (execution_kind = 'local'::text) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (context_body IS NULL) AND (context_sha256 IS NULL) AND (NOT launch_claimed)) OR ((duplicate_of IS NULL) AND (execution_kind = 'model'::text) AND (action = ANY (ARRAY['ask'::text, 'review'::text])) AND (context_body IS NOT NULL) AND (context_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id = ('int10m.'::text || replace((business_key)::text, '-'::text, ''::text))))))

CHECK (((encode(sha256(convert_to(request_body, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text) = request_sha256) AND ((context_body IS NULL) OR (encode(sha256(convert_to(context_body, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text) = context_sha256))))
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, duplicate_of) REFERENCES interview_commands(activity_id, business_key)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, retry_of) REFERENCES interview_commands(activity_id, business_key)
CHECK ((((goal_version = 0) AND (goal_record_id IS NULL) AND (phase = ANY (ARRAY['needs_goal'::text, 'ended'::text]))) OR ((goal_version > 0) AND (goal_record_id IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, current_answer_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, current_feedback_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, current_question_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, goal_record_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, pending_key) REFERENCES interview_commands(activity_id, business_key)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, root_question_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)

CHECK ((((kind = 'answer'::text) AND (origin = 'user'::text) AND (answer_version IS NOT NULL) AND (question_record_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind <> 'answer'::text) AND (answer_version IS NULL) AND (supersedes_record_id IS NULL))))

CHECK ((((origin = 'model'::text) AND (kind = ANY (ARRAY['question'::text, 'probe'::text, 'feedback'::text])) AND (local_body IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL) AND (payload_sha256 = body_sha256)) OR ((origin <> 'model'::text) AND (local_body IS NOT NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL) AND (payload_sha256 IS NULL) AND (encode(sha256(convert_to(local_body, 'UTF8'::name)), 'hex'::text) = body_sha256))))
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, business_key) REFERENCES interview_commands(activity_id, business_key)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, operation_id) REFERENCES activity_operation_results(activity_id, operation_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, question_record_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)
FOREIGN KEY (activity_id, supersedes_record_id) REFERENCES interview_records(activity_id, record_id)

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX interview_command_status ON public.interview_commands USING btree (activity_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_commands_activity_id_operation_id_key ON public.interview_commands USING btree (activity_id, operation_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_commands_pkey ON public.interview_commands USING btree (activity_id, business_key)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_live_slot ON public.interview_commands USING btree (activity_id, semantic_slot) WHERE ((duplicate_of IS NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'started'::text, 'unknown'::text, 'committed'::text, 'history'::text])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_heads_pkey ON public.interview_heads USING btree (activity_id)
CREATE INDEX interview_record_parents ON public.interview_records USING gin (parent_ids)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_records_activity_id_business_key_ordinal_key ON public.interview_records USING btree (activity_id, business_key, ordinal)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_records_activity_id_question_record_id_answer_ver_key ON public.interview_records USING btree (activity_id, question_record_id, answer_version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_records_activity_id_seq_key ON public.interview_records USING btree (activity_id, seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interview_records_pkey ON public.interview_records USING btree (activity_id, record_id)

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER interview_command BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.interview_commands FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION interview_command_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER interview_head BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.interview_heads FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION interview_head_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER interview_record_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.interview_records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION interview_record_immutable_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER interview_record_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.interview_records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION interview_record_insert_guard()

functions.prosrc: BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'interview records are immutable'; END;

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.interview_commands c JOIN public.interview_heads h USING(activity_id)
  JOIN public.interview_records ir ON ir.activity_id=c.activity_id AND ir.business_key=c.business_key AND ir.origin='model'
  JOIN public.activities a ON a.id=c.activity_id
  JOIN public.activity_operations o ON o.activity_id=c.activity_id AND o.operation_id=c.operation_id
  JOIN public.activity_operation_results r ON r.activity_id=o.activity_id AND r.operation_id=o.operation_id
 WHERE c.activity_id=aid AND c.operation_id=op AND c.duplicate_of IS NULL AND c.effect_applied AND c.status IN ('committed','history')
  AND NOT c.obsolete AND c.goal_version=h.goal_version AND c.scope_revision=h.scope_revision AND h.scope_revision=a.scope_revision
  AND a.status<>'cancelled' AND ir.operation_id=c.operation_id AND ir.payload_sha256=r.payload_sha256 AND ir.body_sha256=r.payload_sha256
  AND r.admission_id=o.admission_id AND r.execution_generation=o.execution_generation AND r.scope_revision=o.scope_revision AND o.state='received' AND o.kind='model'
  AND r.payload_format='json'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources s LEFT JOIN public.material_sources m ON m.id=s.source_id
    WHERE s.activity_id=aid AND (m.id IS NULL OR m.current_version IS DISTINCT FROM s.version_id OR m.revision<>s.source_revision))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_scope_sources WHERE activity_id=aid)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.activity_memory_bindings WHERE activity_id=aid))
